summary: ‘Full-STAC’ omits two assets central to the DHIS2/HISP model: configurable metadata/content and an open implementation …
comment: ‘Full-STAC’ omits two assets central to the DHIS2/HISP model: configurable metadata/content and an open implementation community. Content can be covered by open content and open architectures, although SMART guidelines are presented as the only option, rather than a country-owned terminology system. We also would argue the community and ecosystem of successful DPI implementations should be acknowledged as a key enabling condition which promotes national DPI-H sustainability.

reviewer.name: Brian O'Donnell (on behalf of HISP-UiO)
reviewer.organisation: HISP Centre at University of Oslo
